key_insight: GMMag generates crystal structures with site-resolved magnetic moments and redirects sampling toward chemical and magnetic targets without retraining.
engineering_relevance: The workflow supports targeted magnetic-material discovery while estimating how repeated chemical formulas constrain the yield of distinct candidates under finite sampling budgets.
method: Conditional variational autoencoder with a graph neural network encoder and transformer decoder.
Gaussian-mixture sampling to retarget generation toward selected chemical and magnetic properties.
Yield model accounting for repeated chemical formulas during candidate generation.
evidence_signal: The study evaluates architecture, magnetic-moment representations and sampling choices, tests its yield model in two separate ten-million-draw runs, and identifies Nd-containing candidates with formulas absent from the reference dataset, negative formation energies and high estimated saturation magnetization.
watch_item: A higher screening pass rate need not produce more distinct qualifying formulas, and the reported candidates are not evidence of experimental validation.
paper_title: Magnetic crystal generation with site-resolved magnetic moments via Gaussian-mixture retargeting and finite-budget yield prediction
